newsitem.title: USA: Eco2 to sell ownership stake in Spa Faucet.
newsitem.headline: Eco2 to sell ownership stake in Spa Faucet.

text.p: Eco2 Inc said it has reached an agreement to sell its ownership interest in Spa Faucet Inc to an investment group.

"As our shareholders are aware, in the past ECO2 has made investments in companies in unrelated industries. In order to concentrate on further developing our core technologies, ECO2 has decided to sell its interest in other unrelated businesses at this time," said president Charles Ledford.
Eco2 also announced the company's strategic business plan for 1997. It said its primary objective remains the development of company owned pyrolysis facilities.
It said that to date, it has been cautious in proceeding with capital intensive construction of additional facilities due to regulatory volatility.
"Many of our shareholders misunderstand pyrolysis and ECO2. Pyrolysis is a process by which waste or scrap materials are basically converted back to their original components," Ledford said.

ECO2 said it believes the agreement with the Moscow Ministry of Finance will be finalized in the near future. It said it is currently negotiating specific terms of a sales agreement with its export representative and with government officials in Moscow.
